name: JUST Applied Academic & Professional English 2026–27
description: Applied Academic & Professional English: English for Study, Research and Work. A supplementary/optional JUST Zhangjiagang course bridging knowing English → using English effectively. assessments.name: Term 1 Learning / Performance Portfolio
assessments.description: Recommended weighting if a numerical grade is required: 20%. Evidence of usable competence across the term.

assessments.name: Source-Based Position
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 20%. Approximately two-minute source-based position with revision after feedback.

assessments.name: Major Explainer / Presentation
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 20%. Explain major-related content clearly for a non-specialist audience.

assessments.name: Integrated Academic Capstone
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 30%. Integrated academic communication performance.

assessments.name: Reflection and Demonstrated Growth
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 10%. Baseline comparison, portfolio selection and next-term goal.

assessments.name: Professional Communication Portfolio
assessments.description: Recommended weighting if a numerical grade is required: 20%.

assessments.name: Interview / Interaction Performance
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 15%. Direct, evidence-supported professional interaction.

assessments.name: Data Update + Recommendation Task
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 20%. Explain data, make a recommendation and defend it under questioning.

assessments.name: Final Professional Capstone
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 35%. Multi-mode professional communication showcase.

assessments.name: Reflection and Demonstrated Growth
assessments.description: Recommended weighting: 10%. End-of-year portfolio, baseline comparison and transfer plan.

resources.title: Course pathway model
resources.notes: Four task-context pathways: Graduate / Research; Industry / Engineering; Business / International; General Development. These are not separate classes.

resources.title: Support / Core / Stretch differentiation guide
resources.notes: Use one shared task with three layers. Support: frames, model language, vocabulary bank, shorter source, preparation time, notes. Core: expected university task. Stretch: less scaffolding, extra source, counterargument, spontaneous Q&A, more technical/professional audience, tighter time.

resources.title: Responsible AI principles
resources.notes: AI may assist. AI output must be checked. The student remains responsible. When appropriate preserve original attempt, AI-assisted version, verification and final human revision.

resources.title: CET-transfer boundary
resources.notes: This is not a CET preparation curriculum. Reading efficiency, vocabulary in context, listening, summarising, writing and argumentation may transfer naturally; optional exam-oriented practice must not consume the main course.

resources.title: 90-minute production-oriented lesson spine
resources.notes: Approximate sequence: 0–10 retrieval/warm-up; 10–20 output challenge; 20–40 targeted input/modelling/noticing; 40–60 guided practice/rehearsal; 60–75 main production; 75–85 feedback; 85–90 improved attempt/exit ticket.
